items.text: Kamara (back) was a limited practice participant Wednesday.

items.name: Quinshon Judkins
items.text: Judkins (foot) didn't participate in Wednesday's practice, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

items.name: Michael Penix
items.text: Penix (ribs) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.name: CeeDee Lamb
items.text: Lamb (thigh) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

items.name: Braxton Berrios
items.text: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: TreVeyon Henderson
items.text: The Patriots listed Henderson (ankle) as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

items.name: Jeremiyah Love
items.text: Love (ankle) won't practice Wednesday, as head coach Mike LaFleur said the Cardinals want to "get this ankle right and do it the right way," Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.name: A.J. Brown

items.name: A.J. Brown
items.text: Brown (ankle) was a limited practice participant Wednesday.

items.name: Keenan Allen
items.text: Allen was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to rest.

items.name: Josh Downs
items.text: Downs was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to a hamstring injury and rest.

items.name: Tony Pollard
items.text: Pollard was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to rest.

items.name: Chris Olave
items.text: Olave didn't practice Wednesday due to an illness, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

items.name: Tyjae Spears

items.name: Omar Cooper
items.text: Cooper (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.

items.name: Kenyon Sadiq

items.name: Darren Waller
items.text: Waller was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's practice estimate due to a toe injury.

items.name: Jalen Coker
items.text: Coker (quadriceps) was listed as a full participant on the Panthers' estimated injury report Wednesday, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

items.name: Rico Dowdle
items.text: Dowdle (toe) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

items.name: Colin Holderman
items.text: Holderman underwent surgery Wednesday to relieve recurring tendinitis in his right wrist, Zack Meisel of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Adonai Mitchell
items.text: Adonai Mitchell had surgical procedure on finger, expected to miss Week 6. Jets receiver Adonai Mitchell underwent a surgical procedure last month on his injured finger and is expected to miss a fourth consecutive game Sunday.

items.name: Marvin Harrison
items.text: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed Wednesday that Harrison will make his team debut Sunday versus the Jaguars in London, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.name: Jalen Nailor
items.text: Nailor (concussion) isn't participating in Wednesday's practice, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Joshua Jefferson
items.text: Jefferson (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game versus the Heat, per Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.

items.name: Ladd McConkey
items.text: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said McConkey (foot) will practice Wednesday, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

items.name: Ashton Jeanty
items.text: Head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that Jeanty is "starting to feel a lot better physically," and the Raiders have had no discussions of resting him, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "I'm excited about giving him even more reps in practice and more full-speed reps," Kubiak said.

items.name: David Montgomery
items.text: Montgomery (groin) isn't practicing Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.name: Rashee Rice
items.text: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said that Rice (hamstring/knee) won't practice Wednesday, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
items.text: Ristolainen (upper body) won't travel with the Flyers ahead of Thursday's game against the Red Wings but is closing in on a return, Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports reports.

items.name: Shohei Ohtani
items.text: MLB playoffs 2026: Will Shohei Ohtani break his slump?. An ailing Ohtani will remain in the Dodgers' lineup, but L.A. needs him to get his groove back. Now.

items.name: Breece Hall
items.text: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (quadriceps) won't practice Wednesday and remains week-to-week, Al Iannazzone of Newsday reports.

items.name: Adonai Mitchell
items.text: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that Mitchell (finger) underwent a small procedure on his hand and remains week-to-week, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Dillon Brooks
items.text: Brooks is unlikely to suit up for Wednesday's preseason meeting with San Antonio after sitting out the full morning shootaround, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.name: Caleb Williams
items.text: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that Williams (hamstring) will be listed as a full practice participant on Wednesday's estimated injury report, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.
